description: This file defines the main React component for the admin dashboard page of a travel planning web application. It manages user data, dashboard statistics, and user actions such as role changes and deletions. The component fetches data from external APIs and renders a user interface with search, stats, and management functionalities.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Fetches user list and admin statistics from external APIs, with fallback data on error.

methods.name: handleRoleChange
methods.description: Updates a user's role locally and via API call.

methods.name: handleDeleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a user after confirmation, updating local state and calling the API.
